d2_real_serve_deployment.details: Production LLMRouter/KVAwareRouter, exact-HEAD KVTokenTracker, Dynamo SelectionService, two distinct healthy CPU mock LLMServer replicas, LongPoll membership, two schedulable workers, no router fallback, clean shutdown.

d3a_real_http_booking.details: Client request ID reached production tracker and native Dynamo booking; selected worker and serving replica were consistent; prompt token IDs were nonempty; active router used the exact tracker and no fallback.

d3b_normal_cancellation.details: Normal routing completed before timeout, so cancellation and abandoned cleanup were not exercised.

d3b2_native_pending.details: Supported Dynamo queue backpressure produced pending_count=1 while two distinct priming reservations held positive prefill load.

d3b2_http_path_split.details: Production HAProxy fallback served the external request after the ingress LLMRouter timed out. External 200 is not evidence of successful KV-aware booking for X.

d3b2_cancellation_handler_reachability.details: Complete snapshots show the production _free_abandoned_reservation(X, reserve) coroutine on the exact tracker with the original pending reserve Future.

d3b2_cleanup_completion.details: The reserve Future remained pending; no X selection result, terminal cleanup, or free_reservation(X) was observed or safely inferred.

same_id_stale_free.details: The 2026-10-30 counterexample remains valid only for its explicitly gated ordering. D3B-2 did not add Same-ID reuse or worker retirement.

raw_summary_policy: Original runtime summaries are preserved byte-identically where selected. Retrospective corrections are separate artifacts and do not rewrite original classifications.
